author: Craig Jones
title: Mike Khouw's Apple Options Trade
text:
3 Gems From Buffett's Birthday Interview: Apple, Buybacks, And A Cautionary View On Packaged Goods Brands (Seeking Alpha)
On CNBC's "Options Action" , Mike Khouw recommended a long position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ). The stock is trading close to its all-time highs, so he wants to use options to limit risk.
Khouw wants to buy the October 230/245 call spread for a total cost of $4.40. The trade breaks even at $234.40 or 2.97 percent above the current stock price. If the stock jumps to $245 or higher at the October expiration, the trade is going to reach its maximal profit of $10.60. © 2018 Benzinga.com. Benzinga does not provide investment advice.
